research_object: deidentified Chinese adult-film title wording only
inference_boundary: Encode visible title wording only. Do not infer video content, real events, identity, consent, authorization, harm, intention, agency, experience, audience effects, or causality.

definitions.privacy_chain_relevant: The title visibly refers to making/capturing intimate material, obtaining/possessing such material, distributing/uploading/sharing/leaking/selling/publishing it, or its exposure/being seen/discovered.
definitions.creation_visible: The title visibly presents filming, photographing, recording, capturing, or self-producing the material.
definitions.distribution_visible: The title visibly presents uploading, sending, sharing, leaking, publishing, releasing, selling, or otherwise transmitting the material. Mere receipt or possession is not distribution.
definitions.exposure_visible: The title visibly presents the material/person being exposed, publicly available, seen, discovered, or watched as a privacy-chain consequence. Do not treat ordinary sexual visibility as privacy exposure.
definitions.not_relevant: No visible creation/acquisition/distribution/privacy-exposure wording. Sexual content alone is not a privacy chain.

dependencies: If rv is technical_noise or unknown, all four remaining fields are not_applicable.
If privacy is not_relevant, creation/distribution/exposure are all not_applicable.
If privacy is relevant, each stage is independently visible, absent, or unclear; none is not_applicable.
If privacy is unclear, all three stages are unclear.
A selfie creator is not automatically a distributor; a recipient or possessor is not automatically a distributor.
No evidence array is requested in this routing benchmark.
